about.title: ABOUT ME
about.subtitle: I’m a Frontend Developer who enjoys turning ideas into modern, responsive, and user-friendly web experiences.
about.paragraph1: I’m a Frontend Developer who enjoys turning ideas into thoughtful, interactive, and responsive web experiences. My journey into development has been driven by curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding how things work and how they can be made better.
about.paragraph2: I primarily work with JavaScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, while continuously expanding my knowledge across the modern web development ecosystem. I learn best by building, experimenting, solving problems, and turning what I learn into real projects.
about.paragraph3: My background in Social Sciences has also shaped the way I think about people, communication, and how users interact with the things we build. I’m currently looking for remote, full-time opportunities where I can contribute to meaningful projects while continuing to grow as a developer.
about.paragraph4: When I’m away from the screen, you’ll usually find me playing volleyball, working out, or listening to a good podcast.
